# Portal

Renders children into a different part of the DOM tree, typically for modals and overlays.

## When to Use

- Modal dialogs that need to escape parent overflow
- Tooltips/popovers that need to render at body level
- Any UI that needs to break out of its container

## Jumpstart Implementation

| Jumpstart Component | Description |
|---------------------|-------------|
| `Portal` | DOM portal wrapper |

For code examples and API details, use the Jumpstart MCP tools:
- `get-jumpstart-components-apis` with `["Portal"]`
- `get-jumpstart-components-examples` with `["Portal"]`
